source: Northbrook Borough Council publication scheme (fictional council)
licence: Fictional data written for this project

records.title: Spending over £500
records.description: Every payment to suppliers over £500, with date, supplier, amount, service area and purpose. Published under the Local Government Transparency Code.

records.title: Contracts register
records.description: All contracts and tenders over £5,000: supplier, description, start and end dates, total value and procurement route. Published under the Local Government Transparency Code.

records.title: Senior officer remuneration
records.description: Names, job titles, salaries, bonuses and expenses of the chief executive and directors, and the number of staff paid over £50,000 in £5,000 salary bands. Published under the Local Government Transparency Code.

records.title: Pay policy statement
records.description: The council's pay policy, including pay of chief officers, lowest-paid employees, and the ratio between the highest salary and the median salary.

records.title: Gender pay gap report
records.description: Mean and median gender pay gap, bonus gap and the proportion of men and women in each pay quartile.

records.title: Councillor allowances and expenses
records.description: Basic and special responsibility allowances, travel and subsistence expenses paid to each councillor.

records.title: Committee meetings, agendas, reports and minutes
records.description: Agendas, reports, decisions and minutes for Full Council, Cabinet, Planning Committee, Licensing Committee and scrutiny committees.

records.title: Statement of accounts
records.description: Audited annual accounts, including officers' remuneration notes, the number of employees paid over £50,000 by band, exit packages and members' allowances.

records.title: Parking annual report
records.description: Penalty charge notices issued, income from parking charges and fines, appeals and cancellations, and how any surplus was spent.

records.title: Land and building assets register
records.description: Every piece of land and every building the council owns or leases, with location, tenure and use. Published under the Local Government Transparency Code.

records.title: Fraud data
records.description: Number of counter-fraud staff, cost of counter-fraud work, number of fraud cases investigated and amount recovered. Published under the Local Government Transparency Code.

records.title: Trade union facility time
records.description: Number of union representatives, time spent on union duties and the cost as a percentage of the pay bill.

records.title: Air quality annual status report
records.description: Nitrogen dioxide and particulate monitoring results from every monitoring site in the borough, including diffusion tubes near the Riverside incinerator, and progress on the air quality action plan.

records.title: Public register of HMO licences
records.description: Licensed houses in multiple occupation: address, licence holder, number of occupants and licence dates.

records.title: Planning applications and decisions
records.description: Planning applications, plans, consultation responses, officer reports and decision notices, searchable by address or reference.

records.title: Waste and recycling performance
records.description: Household waste tonnages, recycling and composting rates, missed collections and fly-tipping incidents.
